title: Tracking a novel loader: PIPEDANCE
author: bltauthor000000003c
summary_l10n: An analysis of the PIPEDANCE loader observed in recent intrusions.

main_content.markdown_l10n:
## Key takeaways

- PIPEDANCE is a novel loader used to stage secondary payloads.
- It uses [process injection](https://example.com/injection) to evade detection.

## Analysis

The loader begins by resolving **kernel32.dll** exports via a custom `PEB` walk.

```
result = walk_peb()
return result
```

### API resolution

Once resolved, the loader calls `VirtualAlloc` to stage the payload in memory.
